entries.note: Long 1983 PMID 6864535 resolves (JPET 226:114-20; no DOI exists); rat ED50 sentence verbatim in abstract; untested correct and opens the strip at 1983.

DOI resolves (PMID 26111126, PMC4816246); sentence verbatim in Discussion, authors' own animal-to-human claim; healthy males, single dose; year 2015 correct. Registry ids stripped from PMC text, registry_date unresolved. Dog-NOAEL exposure ceiling sits in this paper's Methods, not Jenkins.

Dog ED50 sentence verbatim in abstract; no published animal-to-human dose comparison found for any P-CAB; untested correct. Judgement misattributes the dog-NOAEL AUC ceiling to Jenkins 2015; it is in Sakurai 2015 CTG Methods (UK criterion).
Rat ulcer-model sentence verbatim in abstract; untested correct; 1983 opening consistent with the other cells.

Laine verified (PMID 36228734, print 2023); Hori 2011 abstract confirms rat AND dog superiority over lansoprazole. Rule 1 fails: drafter's own juxtaposition. Ashida 2016 (doi:10.1111/apt.13461, PMC4738414) itself states 'a similar finding has been observed in animal studies' (99.0 vs 95.5%, CI 0.36-6.73): cite it, year 2016.

DOI resolves (PMID 29416369, PMC5789071); quote verbatim in abstract; untested correct. NCT02679508 first posted 2016-02-10, results first posted 2023-12-13 confirmed. model_first_use_year null: the FDA pharmacology review (NDA 215151) would date the rodent carcinogenicity studies.

DOI resolves (PMID 39209187, CGH 23:748, print 2025); quote verbatim, abstract only. Label 13.2 verbatim: carcinoid formation 'is considered to be a rodent-specific phenomenon'. ECL hyperplasia 4.9 vs 7.7% despite 3x gastrin, so 'same' is unsupported; contra kept, power and year flagged below.

missing: efficacy: Ashida 2016, Aliment Pharmacol Ther 43:240-51 (doi:10.1111/apt.13461, PMID 26559637, PMC4738414, epub 2015-11, print 2016) is a rule-1 source: Discussion reads 'This is indicative of a stronger and faster clinical effect with vonoprazan, which presumably results from its rapid and strong suppression of gastric acid secretion, and a similar finding has been observed in animal studies.' Healing 99.0 vs 95.5% (diff 3.5%, 95% CI 0.362-6.732); LA C/D 98.7 vs 87.5% (diff 8.8%, CI 2.105-15.448). comparison_stated=true, subjects=patients, product_in_model=true, magnitude=direction_only, source_calls_it=match; Japanese trial, JapicCTI id not recoverable from PMC text. Laine 2023 (NCT04124926, results first posted 2022-07-29 confirmed) stays as the later superiority confirmation. Xiao 2020 (Gut 69:224, PMID 31409606, NCT02388724 results first posted 2019-06-03 confirmed) makes no animal comparison (0 rat/dog/animal sentences) and is non-inferiority only (92.4 vs 91.3%), so it cannot set the year.

safety: the FDA label is the primary source that actually makes the cross-species comparison (13.2 'rodent-specific phenomenon' + 13.1 rat NETs at >=5 mg/kg/day / mouse carcinoids at all male doses + 12.2 human biopsies 'No neoplastic changes were observed'); Uemura 2025 abstract does not set rodent beside human (comparison_stated=false). Cite the label (dailymed setid 0cc52ac5-77ec-4d66-a770-762a1a960914, revised 11/2025) as co-source. Unverified within budget: whether the original 2022/2023 accessdata.fda.gov label already carried 13.2 and the 12.2 biopsy sentence, which would move the comparison year to 2022 or 2023.

safety: Haruma 2023 (3-year VISION interim, doi:10.1186/s12876-023-02772-w, PMID 37127558, PMC10152792) reports 'no neoplastic changes in either group'; could not open (Springer auth redirect). If its Introduction/Discussion sets the rodent carcinoid finding beside the human histology, the contra year is 2023, not 2025.

safety: model_first_use_year for the rodent carcinogenicity model is recoverable from the FDA pharmacology/toxicology review for Voquezna (NDA 215151) or the Japanese Takecab CTD (2015); not checked within budget.

engagement/dose: registry identifiers for Sakurai 2015 CTG (two phase I single-rising-dose studies, Japan 2007 and UK 2007-08) are stripped in the PMC rendering; registry_date should be resolved or recorded as 'no results posted'.

AZD0865 check (not a cell change): Kahrilas 2007 (PMID 17950677) confirmed, healing 76.9/78.2/81.1% at 25/50/75 mg vs esomeprazole 40 mg 81.9%, reversible transaminase rises esp. 75 mg; Dent 2008 (PMID 18184117) confirmed, intragastric pH>4 75% vs 60% (P<0.05), no clinical benefit in NERD. No published animal prediction for AZD0865 either way, and it did not fail to work (it matched esomeprazole), so not 'neg' on either ground. Drafter's call stands.
rule_questions: engagement 'same' rests on a healthy-volunteer PD comparison (Sakurai 2015: healthy males, single dose). The status rule says 'agreed with patient results'; the v2 subjects field admits healthy_volunteers. Decide whether healthy-volunteer PD counts for the engagement cell; if not, this cell is untested until Dent 2008-type patient pH data are paired with the model by a source (none found).

safety: a known species-specific false positive that the sponsor filed as such. 'same' fails on the data (gastrin translated, 625 vs 200 pg/mL, but ECL hyperplasia did not, 4.9 vs 7.7%, and no NETs), so the choice is contra vs untested. 0/139 NETs at 5 years bounds 5-year incidence below ~2.1% (upper 95%), which contradicts a model showing tumours in a large fraction of rats at 0.6x MRHD exposure, but 5 years is ~6% of a human lifetime versus a 24-month rodent lifetime study, so a lifetime-equivalent test has not been run. The brief has no power/duration threshold for when a human null contradicts a lifetime carcinogenicity prediction. I kept contra because the regulator's own label calls the finding rodent-specific; the atlas should state the rule.

year when the comparison is first made in an FDA label (a listed primary source) and later in a peer-reviewed paper: the label's 13.2 'rodent-specific' plus 12.2 human biopsies may predate Uemura 2025 by 2-3 years. Rule 5 says year of the comparison's publication; decide whether label text counts as that publication.

efficacy: when the model predicts superiority on a surrogate (acid secretion vs lansoprazole) and the patient trial is designed as non-inferiority but reports a numerically higher healing rate with a CI excluding 0 (Ashida 2016), does 'same' require a formal superiority test (Laine 2023) or direction only? Under magnitude=direction_only the year is 2016; under formal superiority it is 2023. Both sources now exist, so this is a year rule, not a status rule.
